diagnosis: The scenario fails the Weak Arm gate because checks C1, C2, and C3 are satisfied by the model using only shared facts (S1, S2, S3) to assign personnel (PFC Ortiz, SPC Bell, Sgt. Noor) without needing the private information in PF1, PF2, or PF3. The model is pattern-matching the assignment names to the desk requirements through generic reasoning rather than being forced to use the hidden certification/qualification facts.

C1.why: The certification fact changes the movement-control assignment to PFC Ortiz and requires a qualification confirmation targeting movement_control_desk/PFC_Ortiz.

C2.why: The communications qualification fact changes the communications-log assignment to SPC Bell, requires a qualification confirmation targeting communications_log_desk/SPC_Bell, and supplies the fact that must be cited.

C3.why: The sustainment-system access and fuel-accountability certification change the sustainment-tracking assignment to Sgt. Noor and require a qualification confirmation targeting sustainment_tracking_desk/Sgt_Noor.
